parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels joined together to provide rigidity and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components such as doors, shelves, and drawers, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides the main structure for the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, distributing load evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of MDF for smoothness and cost efficiency.
parts.Functional_description: It provides internal storage space for organizing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the front opening of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior and conceals stored items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a box-like compartment that slides in and out of the cabinet frame, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage for smaller items and is frequently accessed by the user.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails or runners, sliding in and out of the cabinet.
